title: Cannot find project.godot file using '--upwards' in subdirectories
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in: 4.5.stable, 4.6.dev [e82516995]. Perhaps it has always existed from the beginning. ### System information Godot v4.6.dev (e82516995) - macOS Sequoia (15.7.1) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M3 Ultra (Apple9) ### Issue description 1. As shown in the figure, when I am not in the root directory of the project and use the --upwards option, an error occurs indicating that project.godot cannot be found. It works correctly when I am in the root directory or when the --upwards option is not used. 2. A follow-up issue from the first point: when project.godot cannot be found even after reaching the system root directory, the search keeps going upwards. The override.cfg file is only an optional override when project.godot is found. Unlike previous logic, it returns regardless of the value of err. For the second issue, the chdir system call ignores leading "../.." when the path starts with "/../../dir", but String::simplify_path() does not. As a result, the condition "d->get_current_dir() == current_dir" never holds true. Later supplement Found another bug while adding test cases: Cannot find "C:\\" for "C:\\..\\..\\texture.png". Maybe intentionally? ### Steps to reproduce using '--upwards' in subdirectories ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) This issue is not related to the project content.
